posts.title: My Thoughts on running Linux vs Windows
posts.description: The age-old Linux vs Windows vs Mac. This year I finally went into my long-awaited deep-dive moving fully to Linux. Overall, I am quite impressed and happy with Fedora KDE Plasma. Below, I detail down the understanding of what I know about the objective truth between Linux vs Windows. Linux This includes all the major distributions of Linux, e.g. Ubuntu, Fedora, … etc.
